episodes.title: Chapter One: Dead Sea
episodes.summary: Follow Arthur Curry as he tackles the first days of his new role as Atlantis' ruler. He'll need to deal with surface dwellers, underwater threats, and his half-brother, Orm.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Primordius
episodes.summary: Aquaman's reputation is under attack, but no one in Atlantis is taking him seriously. To win his subjects over, he sets out on a journey that leads him straight into a mystery.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Tidal Shift
episodes.summary: After Ocean Master and Pytor Mortikov join forces and the dreaded villain Scavenger enters the fold, Aquaman fights for the hearts and minds of his subjects.
